name: eShram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
summary: A national registry of unorganised workers, including migrant and gig workers, that issues an eShram card and links workers to social security and welfare benefits.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 16 years of age or older.
The applicant must be 59 years of age or younger.

entitlement_rules.text: Registered workers receive an eShram card that gives access to social security and welfare schemes; there is no direct cash benefit.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the eShram helpdesk.
